data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu had 28 GitHub contribution-count commits across five public repositories, led by UTMIST/Misty with 16 and UTMIST/UTMIST with 4. He also contributed to qiuethan/now, qiuethan/Portfolio, and qiuethan/qiuethan, and opened pull requests in UTMIST/Misty#246 and UTMIST/UTMIST#460, #472, #473, and #481. He reviewed pull requests in UTMIST/Misty#206, #221, #228, #229, #230, #233, #234, #241, #242, #243, #244, #245, #246, #247, and #248, as well as UTMIST/UTMIST#456, #462, and #464, and opened issue UTMIST/UTMIST#459.
